text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 30, 2025) for 12 Anglesey Boulevard.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 30, 2025) for 12 Anglesey Boulevard, Folder No. 25 220349 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to July 31, 2026, to the satisfaction of the City.
